title: H289: News Entropy as Macro Risk Signal (Regime Gating)
rationale: arXiv:2309.05560 'New News is Bad News' (2023, but validated in 2024-2025) demonstrates that news novelty — measured as entropy of news text distribution via RNN over a large corpus — predicts negative aggregate stock market returns over the next year and carries a negative cross-sectional risk premium. High entropy = unusual news = market stress signal. The paper shows: (1) entropy is a BETTER out-of-sample predictor of market returns than standard measures; (2) cross-sectional entropy exposure carries a negative risk premium (assets that co-vary positively with entropy hedge aggregate risk); (3) factor is unexplained by existing long-short factors. Design: rather than replicating the full RNN entropy model (requires large news corpus), use a proxy: compute month-over-month KL divergence between NewsAPI topic distributions (word frequency vectors of last 30 days vs prior 30 days) for S&P 500 news. High KL divergence = novel news regime = defensive posture. Layer onto H249/H286 regime framework as a 3rd regime signal. IS gate: KL divergence > 0.3 → shift to BIL (add to existing H249 bear+volatile regime). OOS gate: Sharpe improvement > 0.05 vs H249 baseline (1.031). Prerequisite: $NEWSAPI_KEY available in env.
content:
# H289: News Entropy Regime Signal (arXiv:2309.05560 'New News is Bad News')
# Proxy: month-over-month KL divergence of NewsAPI topic distributions
# High KL divergence = novel/unusual news = defensive posture (BIL)
# Layer onto H249 4-state regime framework as 3rd signal
# IS: 2015-2019, OOS: 2020-2025
# Gate: OOS Sharpe improvement > 0.05 vs H249 baseline (1.031)
#
# KL divergence proxy:
# 1. Fetch 30d and prior-30d news for S&P 500 query via NewsAPI
# 2. Build word frequency vectors (top 200 words, no stopwords)
# 3. Compute KL(current_30d || prior_30d)
# 4. If KL > threshold: high entropy (unusual news) → defensive
#
# Monthly rebalance signal:
# existing H249: SPY 200MA x VIX 4-state
# + H289 layer: if entropy_kl > 0.30 → override to BIL regardless of H249 state
#
# Limitation: NewsAPI free tier has limited history (1 year)
# For historical test, need to substitute with GDELT or Common Crawl news
# Alternative proxy: VIX term structure slope (cheaper, already have data)
